problem.title: Browser History with Multiple Windows
problem.problemStatement: Design a browser system that supports multiple independent browser windows. Each window maintains its own browsing history and supports: visit(windowId, url) back(windowId, steps) forward(windowId, steps) newWindow(homepage) closeWindow(windowId) currentPage(windowId) Process a sequence of operations and print the result for every currentPage(), back(), and forward() operation.
problem.output: Print the required results after each query operation.
problem.constraints: 1 <= q <= 2 × 10^5 Total number of simultaneously open windows does not exceed 10^5
